zh.explain: 像抱着老虎爬高山，真是战战兢兢、胆破心寒。幸好在前方遇得高人相助，万事无虞，人也因此一生平安。
divination: 危险就在眼前，胆战心惊，前程受阻。
如果要询问如何计谋策划，终究是很辛苦的事。
zh.summary: 此卦抱虎过山之象。所祈求之事会有凶险，而且令人惊恐。

verse: Like dragging a tiger up the mountains,
You tremble with fear as you steel your gall.
Luckily you meet an expert at the front of the mountain,
You survive safe and sound with a life to dwell.
interpretation: There are dangers and obstacles in your path.
You will need to labor hard if you want your plans to work.
meaning: Like a man carrying a tiger up the mountains,
there is fear and danger ahead.
en.explain: There is a feeling of fear and trepidation, like carrying a tiger to climb a mountain, frightening one to death. Fortunately, you meet an expert benefactor up front, so everything is safe and you can lead a safe life.
divination: Danger is ahead, tremble with fear, the future is perilous and full of obstacles. If your query is regarding planning and strategy, the answer is: it will be a very difficult process.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings
Unfavourable, pray to Triple Gems for blessing

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' (18 items). zh keys 官司状况 and 疾病情况 copied as printed. en uses 'Traveller'.
